CHRONIC CARE LOOP · DAMAN × HICC

Find who needs care, plan it, call them, learn from the outcome.

Three connected prototypes. The briefing explains the loop. The studio builds cohorts and scores members. The portal is where nurses call members and keep their care plans moving. Outcomes flow back into the next nightly run.

↩ Outcomes are the only way back: the nightly run re-scores Signals and refreshes MemberFeature values from them.
Reuse before you createDescribe searches existing features first. Only what the catalogue cannot express becomes a new graph feature.
One need, one actionA current care-plan need and its action share a need_key. Closing one closes the other.
Write events, not stateThe portal records outcomes. It never edits scores or triggers directly.
All member data in these prototypes is synthetic. Built from src/ with python3 tools/bundle.py; see README.
